briefing: Field Report from Agent Polaris: Multiple cases of fraud have been reported in Minnesota, including an $11M Medicaid fraud case and allegations against several autism centers. A defendant in the Medicaid case has skipped court, forfeiting their bond. The FBI is actively investigating these cases. I am concerned about the scale of these alleged frauds and the potential for further cases. I will continue to track these investigations and look for connections between entities and programs.
